newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen December comp-store sales up. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Walgreen December comp-store sales up. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: Walgreen Co said Friday its December comparable-store sales rose 7.7 percent from a year earlier.
It said total sales for the month gained 13.6 percent, to $1.43 billion from $1.26 billion a year ago.
Pharmacy sales, which account for 45 percent of overall sales, increased 19 percent overall in December, while comparable-pharmacy sales rose 13.5 percent.
Sales in calendar 1996 were $12.31 billion, up 13.9 percent from $10.81 billion for 1995, it said.
For the first four months of its fiscal year, sales were $4.49 billion, up from $3.95 billion a year earlier.
At December 31 Walgreen operated 2,238 drugstores, up from 2,117 a year ago.
The company said it will report fiscal 1997 first quarter earnings on Monday.
